scope: Seven actual full rendered pages independently inspected. This is coverage adjudication and authoring direction, not approval of any new question.

decisions.reason: PCA is dimensionality reduction, not itself a clustering algorithm. Preserve its slide placement as a source caveat and test clustering labels versus projection.
decisions.primaryEvidenceScope: Official current PCA class documentation was opened and read; it describes centered-data linear dimensionality reduction. No install or PCA execution was needed.

decisions.reason: Habitat-Sim is a simulator that can use scene datasets; do not treat the slide's 100K photo-real scans as a verified simulator dataset size. Preserve embodied-navigation relevance and distinguish simulator from loaded dataset.
decisions.primaryEvidenceScope: Official project homepage was opened and read; Habitat-Sim is physics-enabled 3D simulation with supported scene datasets. The slide count is not validated.

decisions.reason: The emotion/intelligence quotation is an attributed opinion, not a technical proposition demonstrated by the source. Exclude quote attribution trivia only; preserve all seven substantive summary rows and their existing question links.
decisions.primaryEvidenceScope: Actual page personally viewed; the bottom quotation supplies no proof or examinable mechanism. Preserve original wording in source, not a new factual assertion.

decisions.reason: Do not repeat Crystal as the first stable 2017 ROS2 release or Jazzy as timeless latest. Distinguish the dated slide sequence from corrected release history and software-version selection. Preserve the other source milestones.
decisions.primaryEvidenceScope: Official ROS2 historical distribution table search result supplied Ardent 2017-12-08, Bouncy 2018-07-02, Crystal 2018-12-14. Direct current rolling releases page was denied; no alternate retry. No current latest-release claim is authorized by this evidence.

decisions.reason: The .action definition has goal/result/feedback sections, but the cited ROS2 transport design uses three services (send_goal,cancel_goal,get_result) and two topics (feedback,status), not three internal topics. Distinguish definition fields from transport endpoints.
decisions.primaryEvidenceScope: Official design document opened and read including middleware section, service/topic names and cancellation acceptance. This is document-based verification, not a live ROS run.

decisions.reason: Do not infer a volumetric 3D grid from RViz rendering in 3D. nav_msgs/OccupancyGrid is a 2D grid; the slide card's 2D or3D wording needs explicit qualification.
decisions.primaryEvidenceScope: Official nav_msgs package search result explicitly describes a2D grid. Direct message page was denied; no alternate retry. Scope to this standard message, not every occupancy representation.
